lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows across the visible flank, with higher density observed in the anterior-most visible section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running parallel to the spine, displaying a high-contrast luminance gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance spots contained within the leading edge and central surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe truncation of the caudal fin; the tail is entirely absent posterior to the peduncle, terminating in a dark, flat-edged stump indicative of a full amputation.
